environment: Ubuntu WSL, real systemd, Python 3.10.22, SQLite 3.53.1

root_cause.consequence: Databases restored but guard could not be cleared by the service identity; old units did not restart

repairs: Run installer backup restore and backup activate through as_service, matching snapshot, migration and confirmation identity
Persist rollback state before restore, after restore and after activation; renew the bounded controller lease before authorization
Permit rollback state only for a live exact controller, explicit false business boundary and matching complete old snapshot
Reject missing, null and numeric-false boundary flags during rollback confirmation

regressions.proof: Four previous active units restored; initially inactive units preserved; guard/active transaction removed; confirmation executed as UID65534 with exit0
Real systemd expired-lease scenario, 18 direct rollback tests and 10 confirmation boundary/failure tests
Restore durability, abrupt crash recovery, repeated rollback and complete snapshots

lease_simulation: The test-owned restore helper atomically rewrites its private controller updated_at to 30 seconds old after restore; no long sleep or production hook.
limitations: Focused scopes overlap and are not final full regression
Systemd business helpers are synthetic; dependency setup is simulated
No real Lark, Gemini, collector or remote restic calls
No commit, push or production deployment
Clean candidate and VPS gates remain open
cleanup: Each systemd fixture stopped exact owned services/timers, checked zero PIDs and removed exact owned unit files; evidence directories retained
